test_title: SSC CHSL Tier-1 2022: Official Paper (Held On: 20 March, 2023 Shift 3)
subject: general
question:
Some parts of a sentence have been jumbled up, and labelled P, Q, R and S. Select the option that gives the correct sequence in which these parts can be rearranged to form a meaningful and grammatically correct sentence.

Many retailers have invested

P. time and money into understanding its

Q. make them healthier so they can continue to be marketed

R. promotions work, and changing product ingredients to

S. complexity, refitting shops, trialling which healthier
solution:
The correct answer is **'Option 1'.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• The correct sequence is indeed **PSRQ**.

 
 
• **P.** time and money into understanding its
 
• **S. **complexity, refitting shops, trialling which healthier
 
• **R. **promotions work, and changing product ingredients to
 
• **Q. **make them healthier so they can continue to be marketed
 
 
 
• This **sentence makes sense** as it tells a story about the efforts of many retailers to understand the complexity of making healthier options appealing to customers.
 
• **These efforts include** refitting their shops, testing out different healthier promotions, and even altering the ingredients of their products to make them healthier, so they can continue to be marketed as such.

When **we arrange the sentence** as per** PSRQ,** we get:* "Many retailers have invested time and money into understanding its complexity, refitting shops, trialling which healthier promotions work, and changing product ingredients to make them healthier so they can continue to be marketed."*
